name: Robotic Joint Replacement
short_desc: VELYS robotic knee and hip surgery — sub-millimetre precision, no pre-op CT, faster recovery, cashless insurance.
meta_description: VELYS robotic knee replacement and robotic hip surgery in Ahmedabad at DHS Hospital — imageless, sub-millimetre precision, cashless insurance.
full_desc:
DHS Multispecialty Hospital is one of Ahmedabad's leading destinations for robotic-assisted joint replacement. Our Robotic Surgery programme is led by Dr. Hardik Shah (Medical Director, MS Orthopedic, FRCS Germany) and Dr. Swagat Shah (FIAAS UK), supported by a senior orthopedic team that has successfully performed 2,000+ knee replacement surgeries (robotic and conventional) with high patient satisfaction.

DHS uses the VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution from Johnson & Johnson DePuy Synthes — the fastest-growing robotic knee platform in India since its November 2022 launch. Unlike older CT-based platforms (Mako, ROSA), VELYS is imageless: there is no pre-operative CT scan, no extra radiation, and a faster pre-surgical workup. Specialised probes register your knee's anatomy during surgery, software models ligament tension and movement in real time, and the robotic arm guides bone cuts with sub-millimetre precision. Published data on VELYS shows strong alignment accuracy compared with manual technique, complication rates comparable to experienced-surgeon manual TKA, and strong early-functional scores.

DHS performs VELYS robotic total knee replacement, partial (uni-condylar) knee replacement, revision knee replacement, and robotic-assisted hip replacement, paired with the J&J Attune knee implant system. Most patients stand and walk aided on day 0, are discharged in 2–3 days, return to daily activities in 4–6 weeks, and reach full recovery at 3–4 months. VELYS robotic knee replacement at DHS typically costs ₹2,50,000 to ₹3,50,000 for a single knee (indicative all-inclusive range; final figure depends on implant choice, room category, and length of stay). Cashless treatment is available with all major insurers and TPAs — call our billing desk at +91 9081021444 for a personalised written estimate.
